FIXED 2x2 SCENE GRID FORMAT
Use a clean canvas divided into a precise 2x2 grid with visible thin border lines separating each panel. Maintain consistent global lighting and art style, but enforce strict compositional differences between panels.

左上 MAIN VIEW（主视图）：标准广角/中焦镜头，展示场景最具代表性的核心正面视角，呈现整体空间结构、视觉焦点及基础环境氛围。
右上 TOP-DOWN FLOOR PLAN（实际空间布局俯视图）：正俯视或45°轴测俯视视角，基于 MAIN VIEW物理空间绘制，展示场景布局。
左下 45° angled side view（45度侧视图）：基于俯视平面图推导生成，与主视图形成45°的三分之一侧向透视角度。
右下 EXTREME CLOSE-UP DETAIL（极近局部特写）：画面仅容纳单一关键细节，填满整个画格，背景完全虚化消失。

身份锁定
<3–5 行，每行一个可验证的标志性事实，从用户描述提取：SPATIAL STRUCTURE, CORE ARCHITECTURE/PROPS, PRIMARY LIGHT SOURCE, COLOR PALETTE / ENVIRONMENTAL MOOD>
所有视图中保持光影方向、材质纹理、配色分区、环境元素绝对一致。

    "元辰，Young reedy voice, quick and rough, sentences cut short, always a little out of breath, louder than the open ground really needs him to be.",

Warm low sun reaches across the courtyard from the west, softening the stone and laying long amber bars on the flagstones, dust hanging in the light; grainy 35mm period footage in muted indigo, ochre and ash grey.",
    "山溪，A mountain stream running shallow over rounded grey stones, a gravel shelf at the bend, wet rock polished by runoff, moss darkening the shaded bank, reeds and wild mint crowding the edge, a fallen log bridging the narrow upper reach, the cliff face climbing steeply behind it so the gully opens as a slot of sky.     "灶房，A temple kitchen under soot-blackened beams, a long brick stove carrying two iron pots, a wooden chopping block, a rack of clay bowls beside a crock of pickled greens, sacks of millet stacked against the wall, bundles of firewood reaching the rafters, one small window high in the wall dropping a shaft of daylight onto the floor. A single oil lamp hangs low over the stove and throws a hard pool of light on the bricks while the corners go black; grainy 35mm period footage in deep brown and soot grey with a coal-orange core.",
